event.description: Remove all five LayerNorm additive bias vectors while retaining LayerNorm scales, the rank-8 learned positional factorization, d=14, h=2, L=2, and ff=20.
event.proposal: Family: normalization. Retained incumbent is 3430 parameters at 99.660000%, a +0.660000 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family history: no accepted normalization compression; the most recent failed result was attempt-0011, the no-offset variant under an extended 45000-step, learning-rate-floor schedule, an optimization failure that peaked only 11.5% validation after unstable training; 2 prior family attempts. The immediately preceding tying candidate attempt-0015 is an optimization failure (30000 steps, 7.4% peak validation, no checkpoint), not a scored result. Hypothesis: all learned normalization shifts remain redundant after the newly retained rank-8 learned positional factorization, which the earlier no-offset trials did not use; retaining scales and LayerNorm statistics preserves the normalizing mechanism while removing 70 actual scalar parameters (3430 to 3360). This is parameterization-preserving scalar compression rather than a representational substitution. It is more informative than the nearest untested alternative RMSNorm because it changes only additive offsets and, unlike the prior no-offset runs, isolates their interaction with the accepted positional factorization under the standard schedule.
